0.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_001
0.description: Welcome, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. If you believe your exploits on the battlefield have proven your mettle and are worthy of evaluation, I would hear of them.
0.translation_description: Ti do il benvenuto, Lama <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. Se ritieni che le tue imprese sul campo di battaglia dimostrino il tuo Coraggio e meritino una valutazione, vorrei sentirne parlare.

1.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_002
1.description: That is, of course, assuming you have exploits to report. If you are even half the soldier they say you are, I look forward to your return, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>.
1.translation_description: Certo, purché tu abbia davvero qualche impresa da riferire. Se sei anche solo la metà del soldato che dicono, attendo il tuo ritorno, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503>.

2.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_010
2.description: Ah, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. What news from the front lines?
2.translation_description: Ah, Lama <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. Che notizie arrivano dal fronte?

4.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_A1_000_001
4.translation_description: Mostra le prove del tuo Coraggio.

5.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_A1_000_002
5.translation_description: Chiedi informazioni sui gradi della Resistenza.

7.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_020
7.description: Thank you for your report, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, but it was wholly unnecessary. I daresay there is not a soldier in all the Resistance unaware of your courageous deeds.
7.translation_description: Grazie per il tuo rapporto, Lama <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, ma non ce n'era affatto bisogno. Direi che non c'è soldato della Resistenza che non conosca le tue gesta coraggiose.

8.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_030
8.description: I see... Not the most compelling of reports, but certainly deserving of recognition.
8.translation_description: Capisco... Non è un rapporto molto convincente, ma merita comunque di essere riconosciuto.

9.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_SYSTEM_000_031
9.description: You must raise your mettle by <hex:022206E802FF022C03> for promotion to the next Resistance rank.
9.translation_description: Per passare al grado successivo della Resistenza devi aumentare il tuo Coraggio di <hex:022206E802FF022C03>.

10.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_040
10.description: Were there not other soldiers to account for it, I would believe your report a work of fiction.
10.translation_description: Se non ci fossero altri soldati a confermarlo, penserei che il tuo rapporto sia inventato.

11.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_050
11.description: The troops will no doubt be inspired when they hear of your accomplishments. I look forward to hearing more of your continued success in the field.
11.translation_description: Le truppe saranno senza dubbio ispirate quando sapranno delle tue imprese. Attendo di sentire altri resoconti dei tuoi successi al fronte.

12.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_SYSTEM_000_051
12.description: A new Resistance quest is now available.
12.translation_description: È ora disponibile una nuova missione della Resistenza.

13.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_SYSTEM_000_052
13.description: A new Resistance quest is now available in Zadnor.
13.translation_description: È ora disponibile una nuova missione della Resistenza a Zadnor.

14.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_060
14.description: Ah, before you go. I am pleased to report our quartermaster has seen fit to expand your lost finds holster. I trust you will put our additional stock of resources to good use.
14.translation_description: Ah, prima che tu vada, ho una buona notizia: il quartiermastro ha ampliato la tua fondina dei reperti perduti. Spero che farai buon uso delle risorse aggiuntive.

15.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_065
15.description: I should also mention that research on the forgotten fragments is proceeding apace, and our appraisers are confident they can identify a greater variety of fragments. I pray they will be of use to you in battle.
15.translation_description: Aggiungo che la ricerca sui frammenti dimenticati procede a ritmo spedito e i nostri periti sono convinti di poter identificare una varietà ancora maggiore di frammenti. Spero che ti siano utili in battaglia.

16.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_070
16.description: From what our scouts have told me, the fighting grows fiercer, more desperate with each passing day. I have no doubt you have dealt with such overwhelming odds before, but I would remind you to stay vigilant. There is no telling what they have planned.
16.translation_description: Secondo quanto mi riferiscono i nostri esploratori, i combattimenti diventano ogni giorno più feroci e disperati. Non dubito che tu abbia già affrontato simili difficoltà, ma ti ricordo di restare all'erta. Chissà cosa stanno tramando.

17.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_SYSTEM_000_071
17.description: When fighting at Resistance rank <hex:022003E80203> or higher, incapacitation will result in a loss of mettle.
17.translation_description: Se combatti con un grado della Resistenza pari o superiore a <hex:022003E80203>, finire K.O. comporta la perdita di Coraggio.

18.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_SYSTEM_000_072
18.description: Furthermore, the use of Return after incapacitation will incur an additional penalty to mettle. The penalty incurred will vary depending on your Resistance rank.
18.translation_description: Inoltre, dopo aver finito K.O., l'uso di Ritorno comporta un'ulteriore perdita di Coraggio. L'entità della penalità dipende dal tuo grado della Resistenza.

19.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_080
19.description: If you have nothing else to report, I will not keep you. I pray you stay safe out there, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>.
19.translation_description: Se non hai altro da riferire, non ti trattengo. Stai al sicuro là fuori, Lama <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>.

20.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_090
20.description: If you have nothing else to report, I will not keep you. Unless, of course, there is more to tell of your endeavors on the front lines?
20.translation_description: Se non hai altro da riferire, non ti trattengo. A meno che tu non abbia altre notizie sulle tue imprese al fronte?

21.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_Q2_000_001
21.description: Do you have more to report?

22.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_100
22.description: Hah, I suspected as much. Well, let's have it then.

23.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_105
23.description: Understood. I look forward to your next report, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>.
23.translation_description: Capito. Attendo il tuo prossimo rapporto, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503>.

24.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_110
24.description: By the gods. I would think such feats impossible were they boasted by any other.
24.translation_description: Per gli dèi! Se fosse stato chiunque altro a vantarsi di simili imprese, le avrei credute impossibili.

25.name: TEXT_CTSMYCRESISTANCELEVELUP_00681_RESISTANCEOFFICER_000_111
25.description: On behalf of the Resistance, I extend to you my humblest thanks. With you at our side, hope for a free Bozja shall never be lost.
25.translation_description: A nome della Resistenza, ti ringrazio di cuore. Con te al nostro fianco, la speranza di vedere una Bozja libera non svanirà mai.
